definitions.gloss: shortest, minimum (in distance, time, or length)
definitions.explanation: The superlative of short — the least in distance, duration, or length among a group. Commonly used for routes, time periods, and records.

examples.japanese: {最短|さいたん}⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go by the shortest route.

examples.japanese: {最短|さいたん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It will take three days at the minimum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最短|さいたん}{距離|きょり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ナビ→ナビ：23508_nabi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べて→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}した→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the shortest distance to the destination on the GPS before leaving.

notes:
USAGE:
{最短|さいたん} functions as a noun or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective. It applies to distance, time, and length.
- Distance: {最短|さいたん}⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧ (shortest route), {最短|さいたん}{距離|きょり} (shortest distance)
- Time: {最短|さいたん}で〜 (at the earliest / minimum time)
- Records: {最短|さいたん}⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧ (shortest record)

When used adverbially with で, it means "at the earliest" or "at a minimum" in terms of time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最短|さいたん}{距離|きょり}: shortest distance
- {最短|さいたん}⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧: shortest route
- {最短|さいたん}⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: shortest record
- {最短|さいたん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at the earliest, at minimum
